header.title: System Settings
header.tip: Dynamic configuration is stored in the database and takes precedence over appsettings.json. Leave a field empty to use the default value from the configuration file.

global.title: Global Switches
global.description: Controls overall system behavior. Changes take effect immediately.

pizzaHelper.title: Genshin Pizza Helper
pizzaHelper.description: Upstream configuration for Spiral Abyss data sync. Update here when the Cookie/Salt expires.

afdian.title: Afdian SKU Mapping
afdian.description: Product IDs used for order matching. Update here when products change.

sso.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
sso.description: External OIDC identity provider. Empty fields follow App:Oidc in appsettings/environment variables; changes take effect immediately without a restart.

killSwitch.title: Feature Kill Switches
killSwitch.description: Emergency-disable injection features on clients, delivered via /Patch/hutao and applied on next client launch; turning a switch off restores user-local settings.

maintenanceMode.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenanceMode.hint: When enabled, all non-admin endpoints return a maintenance response

registrationEnabled.label: Allow Registration
registrationEnabled.hint: When disabled, new users cannot register passport accounts

captchaEnabled.label: Enable Captcha
captchaEnabled.hint: When disabled, login/registration no longer verifies reCaptcha

skuGachaLog.label: Wish Log SKU
skuGachaLog.hint: SKU ID of the wish log service in Afdian orders

skuCdn.label: CDN Service SKU
skuCdn.hint: SKU ID of the CDN service in Afdian 2 orders

diagnosticEmail.label: Diagnostic Email
diagnosticEmail.hint: Email address that receives system exception and order diagnostic notifications

sso.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
sso.description: External OIDC identity provider. Empty fields follow App:Oidc in appsettings/environment variables; changes take effect immediately without a restart.

ssoEnabled.label: Enable SSO
ssoEnabled.hint: When off, the admin falls back to maintainer login and no write gate is enforced

ssoClientId.label: Client ID
ssoClientId.hint: The client ID registered at the identity provider

ssoClientSecret.label: Client Secret
ssoClientSecret.hint: Confidential credential, server-side only; keep it in sync with the identity provider

ssoRedirectUri.label: Admin redirect URI
ssoRedirectUri.hint: Must match the registration exactly, e.g. https://api.example.com/Admin/Sso/Callback

ssoClientRedirectUri.label: Launcher redirect URI
ssoClientRedirectUri.hint: Redirect URI for launcher SSO, a different address from the admin one; leave empty to hide the SSO entry in the launcher

ssoDisplayName.label: Display name
ssoDisplayName.hint: Provider name shown on the login button; falls back to frontend copy when empty

ssoBootstrapClaim.label: Bootstrap claim
ssoBootstrapClaim.hint: Claim name for the first admin account, e.g. sub / preferred_username / email

ssoBootstrapValue.label: Bootstrap value
ssoBootstrapValue.hint: The first login whose claim matches this value provisions the seed account

ssoRequireHttps.label: Require HTTPS
ssoRequireHttps.hint: Keep enabled in production; only disable for local http testing

disableFpsUnlock.label: Disable FPS unlock
disableFpsUnlock.hint: Force the FPS unlock off for all clients in the current session

disableIslandInjection.label: Disable Island injection
disableIslandInjection.hint: Force Island injection off for all clients in the current session

form.emptyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default
